card.name: Small words in NSAID label text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "for", "the", "including" or a comma, in NSAID (arthritis drug) labeling. They appear right after an arthritis heading or an NSAID name and come before the use or indication.

modes.label: Linking word before indication
modes.description: "for", "the" or "For" that introduces the treated condition after an NSAID or arthritis heading.
modes.example: The recommended starting dose of etodolac for<< the>> management of the signs and symptoms of oste

modes.description: "for" right after "COX-2 selective NSAID" in the CABG surgery trial text.

modes.label: Inside drug names or lists
modes.description: Part of a drug name or a comma in a symptom list within NSAID labels.
